# GitHub Copilot / Cursor adapter

Real skills live in `../../skills/`, same `SKILL.md` format.

```bash
# Copilot (repo)
python ../../scripts/install.py --skill smart-commit --agent copilot
# copies to .github/skills/<name>/

# Cursor
python ../../scripts/install.py --skill smart-commit --agent cursor
# copies to .cursor/skills/<name>/
```

No content changes required.
